name: Youth Coalition Member (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join the Youth Coalition Member job in Taos, NM. It is part of the Prevention Program.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18. The job is in Taos, NM.
deadline_text: The job runs from Oct 9, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.
how_to_apply: Open the apply page and find the Youth Coalition Member job under Prevention Program. Use the link for that job.
notes: The job runs from Oct 9, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027, per the listing. Hours per week and the last day to apply are not stated on the program page. The Prevention Program listing says its positions are for people pursuing a career in public health addressing substance misuse.
